_about: Wire frames extracted VERBATIM from the upstream OpenClaw unit tests at tag v2026.9.1 (github.com/openclaw/openclaw), adapted only for sessionKey/runId namespacing. Each scenario pins one interpretation contract documented in docs/UPSTREAM_INTERPRETATION.md — the shapes the gateway's own test suite guarantees on the wire. Source test file:line is cited per scenario; the ONE composed scenario (writer-claim-rebound-after-content) says so and cites each part it is built from. Replayed by test/upstream-frames.test.ts; do not edit shapes without re-checking the upstream tag.

aborted-user-stop-partial-text.description: src/gateway/chat-abort.test.ts:495-507 (v2026.9.1) — a killed run broadcasts state:aborted with a free-form stopReason ('user' is a caller value, NOT in any enum) and the partial text snapshot. The turn must finalize aborted on state alone; stopReason must never reclassify it.

aborted-tool-validation-errormessage.description: src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts:3999-4006 (v2026.9.1) — self-abort on tool-validation failure: state:aborted carries stopReason:'aborted' plus errorMessage. An aborted turn keeps its abort status; the errorMessage is diagnostic, never a persisted error.

payload.errorMessage: edit tool validation failed: edits: must be an array

error-timeout-stopreason-precedence.description: src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts:4096-4107 (v2026.9.1) — a timed-out abort (lifecycle end aborted:true stopReason:'timeout') is emitted as state:ERROR, not aborted: the gateway consumes stopReason BEFORE emitting. NEW at 2026.8.x: the payload also carries errorKind:'timeout' (the recorded classification must reach the browser) and NO `message` — the test asserts its absence.

error-errorkind-rate-limit.description: src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts:5111-5126 (v2026.9.1) — a 429 lifecycle error reaches the wire as state:error with errorKind:'rate_limit'. The upstream test asserts the payload has NO `message` and NO `errorDetail` (that field only appears when the runtime recorded a provider observation). The allowlisted wire errorKind survives as the message errorKind.

payload.errorMessage: Provider call failed: 429 Too many requests

writer-claim-rebound-after-content.description: COMPOSED (not copied from one upstream test) — the 2026.8.1+ successor of the 7.1 embedded prompt-lock takeover, which no longer exists (attempt.session-lock.ts is gone since 2026.8.1; transcripts moved to SQLite). Parts, each cited: the message is thrown verbatim by src/config/sessions/transcript-write-context.ts:239 (SessionTranscriptWriterClaimReboundError, identical 8.1->9.1); the error NAME is pinned by src/agents/model-fallback.test.ts:2006-2007; the wire rendering '<Name>: <message>' is pinned by src/gateway/ws-log.test.ts:72-75 (formatForLog), and server-chat.ts:1174 emits it as errorMessage on state:error. CONTRACT: unlike the 7.1 lock flavour, this one is NOT downgraded to complete — upstream itself retries it (subagent-announce-delivery-retry.ts:70 treats it as transitory), so a streamed reply may still be superseded. Atrium keeps the honest error card and classifies the turn session_write_conflict — its OWN class, NOT the retryable session_init_conflict: this one rebounds mid-turn (after the model ran, after tools may have had external effects), so Atrium's bounded auto-retry must not re-dispatch it.

payload.errorMessage: SessionTranscriptWriterClaimReboundError: session writer claim changed before transcript persistence

init-conflict-zero-content.description: src/auto-reply/reply/session-init-conflict-retry.ts:12 (message verbatim; upstream test src/auto-reply/reply/session.init-conflict-retry.test.ts:110,122) — the pre-generation OCC init conflict, unchanged 7.1->9.1. Upstream retries it (up to 5 attempts with backoff); with zero content the bridge classifies it session_init_conflict so its own bounded auto-retry can key on it.

compaction-explicit-stream-signals.description: src/infra/agent-events.test.ts:795-801 + src/plugins/wired-hooks-compaction.test.ts:243-252 (v2026.9.1) — the EXPLICIT mid-turn compaction signal: {stream:'compaction', phase:'start'} then {phase:'end', outcome:'completed', willRetry:true, completed:true}. The overflow retry replays inside the SAME runId with no lifecycle end; accumulated text must survive. NOTE 2026.9.1: start/end also carry an optional itemId correlating one compaction operation (agent-session-compaction.ts:109,461) — not read by the bridge.
